clean_description: Light from Uncommon Stars follows Shizuka Satomi, a violinist who has made a Faustian bargain to save her soul by luring seven prodigies into similar deals. When she discovers Katrina Nguyen, a talented transgender runaway, she believes she has found her final candidate. Their lives intersect with Lan Tran, a retired starship captain, leading to a story that intertwines themes of magic, identity, and the power of family.
